mapper.insert: insert into user_coupon (coupon_id, user_id, status, claim_time, expire_time, use_time, order_id) values (#{couponId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{claimTime}, #{expireTime}, #{useTime}, #{orderId})
mapper.select: select uc.id, uc.coupon_id, sc.name as coupon_name, sc.threshold_amount, sc.discount_amount, case when uc.status = 0 and uc.expire_time is not null and uc.expire_time <= now() then 2 else uc.status end as status, uc.claim_time, uc.expire_time, uc.use_time, uc.order_id from user_coupon uc inner join seckill_coupon sc on sc.id = uc.coupon_id where uc.user_id = #{userId} order by uc.claim_time desc
